en.headline: Salt-water pipe leaks near Kai Tin Shopping Centre in Lam Tin
en.dek: A 200-millimetre salt-water main on Kai Tin Road caused muddy water to flow onto roads and through the mall; the Water Supplies Department shut the valve and said flushing-water supply was unaffected.
body: A salt-water supply pipe leaked on Sunday evening near Kai Tin Shopping Centre in Lam Tin, sending muddy water across pedestrian areas and down slopes onto Kai Tin Road.

Police received a report at about 6pm of a burst underground pipe on On Tin Street outside the mall, with pavement subsidence and large volumes of yellow muddy water. The Water Supplies Department confirmed the pipe was a 200-millimetre salt-water main. After the valve was closed, the flow stopped. The department said flushing-water supply to users was not affected after adjustments.
Repair teams were working on site. Sections of pavement were left muddy and some paving stones were displaced. Nearby shops were not reported to have been affected.

zh.headline: 藍田啟田商場附近鹹水管滲漏 沖廁水供應不受影響
zh.dek: 直徑200毫米鹹水供水管傍晚滲漏，黃泥水沿斜路湧出；水務署關掣後停止湧水，經調度後用戶沖廁水供應正常。
body: 藍田啟田商場附近一條鹹水供水管今日傍晚滲漏，大量黃泥水湧上行人路並沿斜路流向啟田道。
警方約下午6時接獲報案，指啟田商場對開安田街有地底水管爆裂，行人路出現路陷。水務署確認涉事為直徑200毫米鹹水供水管，關上水掣後現場停止湧水，並表示經供水調度後用戶沖廁水供應不受影響。
署方工程團隊正進行維修。現場路面留有泥濘，部分地磚鬆脫或下陷，附近商戶未有受影響的報告。
